rules.title: Prohibition on the Sale or Use of Coordinated Pricing Algorithms
rules.quote: It shall be unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide to City of Berkeley landlords any coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels that may be achieved for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley. It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
rules.summary: Landlords are prohibited from using coordinated pricing algorithms that set or recommend rents or occupancy levels for residential units in Berkeley, and it is unlawful to sell or provide such algorithms to Berkeley landlords.
rules.coverage_text: residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley
rules.exemption_note: Does not include products that publish aggregated anonymous rental data without recommendations, products used for affordable housing rent limits, or products for market research, appraisals, or software development testing
rules.penalty: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each separate month and each separate dwelling unit constitutes a separate violation; prevailing party entitled to reasonable attorney's fees and costs
